mapper.update: CREATE TABLE bike_factory_sales_order ( id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, order_no VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL UNIQUE, request_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE, customer_id BIGINT NOT NULL, warehouse_id BIGINT NULL, business_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, currency_code VARCHAR(3) NOT NULL, details_json JSON NOT NULL, steps_json JSON NOT NULL, revision INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, created_by BIGINT NULL, created_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), updated_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), KEY ix_factory_customer(customer_id,id), KEY ix_factory_warehouse(warehouse_id,id) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE bike_factory_sales_order_link ( factory_order_id BIGINT NOT NULL, order_id BIGINT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(factory_order_id,order_id), UNIQUE KEY uk_factory_fulfillment_order(order_id), CONSTRAINT fk_factory_order_link FOREIGN KEY(factory_order_id) REFERENCES bike_factory_sales_order(id), CONSTRAINT fk_factory_sales_order_link FOREIGN KEY(order_id) REFERENCES bike_sales_order(id) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE bike_sales_settlement ( id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, subject_type VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, subject_id BIGINT NOT NULL, request_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, amount DECIMAL(18,2) NOT NULL, currency_code VARCHAR(3) NOT NULL, occurred_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL, counterparty VARCHAR(200) NULL, reference_no VARCHAR(300) NULL, remark VARCHAR(2000) NULL, status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'CONFIRMED', created_by BIGINT NULL, created_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), reversed_by BIGINT NULL, reversed_at DATETIME(3) NULL, reversal_reason VARCHAR(500) NULL, UNIQUE KEY uk_sales_settlement_request(subject_type,subject_id,request_id) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
